unit.why: A quoted list of a tsaddik's statements about his own and his brother's supernatural sight and foreknowledge (seeing from one end of the world to the other, knowing when visitors set out, sensing weather changes); these are reported sayings and traits, with no narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: Part of a numbered series of praises (ה, ו, ז) about the same tsaddik; this item continues the trait list but is self-contained.
